ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This course, EPS 590 OB, CRN 49028, is taught primarily via interactive video. Class sessions will meet Monday evenings from 6:00-9:00pm. There may be some class face-to-face meetings (the number yet to be determined) held at the Oak Brook Multi-University Center. These face-to-face sessions will meet on Wednesday nights.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC or EDM:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC.
